name: Cave-In!
operation_language: Authoring declarations only; not registered engine opcodes.

authored_operations.requirement: Keep ability, skill/context, DC and optional familiar Help exactly. Choose actor and actual context; settle one branch once; never silently convert an ability check into a saving throw.
Retain order, exact quantities/formulas, recipient, costs, branch descriptions and occurrence identity; no repeated payment when a child resumes.

payload.name: Cave-In!
payload.description: The ceiling groans ominously. Dust rains down and then — CRASH!

success.description: You roll out of the way as tons of rubble crash down behind you.

failure.description: Rocks pummel you before you can escape!

authority: Custom Crown campaign event, not an SRD trap/NPC/spell replacement
occurrence_policy: Table may roll again; same in-flight occurrence must not reroll/reapply on reopen. Campaign-specific uniqueness beyond generated room claims is unresolved, not silently global once-per-event-ID.
